summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as the inter-VLAN router with routed interfaces eth1 (192.168.10.1/24, toward node2) and eth2 (192.168.20.1/24, toward node3), enabled IPv4 forwarding globally and per-interface, and addressed node2's ens7 (192.168.10.2/24) and node3's ens7 (192.168.20.2/24) with static routes to each other's subnet via node1. Verified bidirectional cross-VLAN ping (node2<->node3, TTL=63 confirming the routed hop). Persisted config via /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d on all three nodes. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: rebooted node2, node3, then node1 (SONiC, last since it's the router), one at a time, confirmed each via changed boot_id, and re-verified SONiC container health, interface/forwarding config persistence, and end-to-end cross-VLAN connectivity after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline network state (interfaces, routes, OS) on node1, node2, node3
Neutralized docker0 class-E address conflict on node1 (SONiC)
Assigned 192.168.10.1/24 to node1 eth1 and 192.168.20.1/24 to node1 eth2
Enabled net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding on node1
Assigned 192.168.10.2/24 to node2 ens7 with static route to 192.168.20.0/24 via node1
Assigned 192.168.20.2/24 to node3 ens7 with static route to 192.168.10.0/24 via node1
Verified bidirectional cross-VLAN ping between node2 and node3 (TTL=63)
Persisted interface config on node1 via /etc/network/interfaces.d/vlan-routing.cfg and sysctl via /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf
Persisted interface/route config on node2 and node3 via /etc/network/interfaces.d/vlan-routing.cfg
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and recovered VLAN config + cross-VLAN ping
Restarted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and recovered VLAN config + cross-VLAN ping

Restarted node1 (SONiC) last, polled through extended downtime until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified all 9 SONiC containers healthy, interface addressing and forwarding sysctls persisted
Re-verified end-to-end bidirectional cross-VLAN connectivity after all three restarts

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 reach each other across the VLAN boundary (bidirectional)

evidence.requirement: config persists across reboot (not just runtime state)
evidence.summary: static interfaces.d and sysctl.d files written on all nodes; post-reboot ip addr/route output on node2, node3, node1 matches the persisted config
